{
    "manifest_version": 2,
    "name": "dstack-nvidia-0.5.11",
    "runner": "docker-compose",
    "docker_compose_file": "services:
  
  # OpenTelemetry collector sidecar for stable management visibility only.
  otelcol-management:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib@sha256:85ac41c2db88d0df9bd6145e608a3cb023f5d8443868adbfbbf66efb51087917
    container_name: otelcol-management
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol-management/config.yaml"]
    user: "0:0"
    mem_limit: "768m"
    environment:
      - MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN=${MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN}
      - CVM_NAME=${CVM_NAME}
      - CVM_HOST=${CVM_HOST}
      - DD_HOSTNAME=${DD_HOSTNAME}
      - ENV=${ENV}
      - CVM_HOSTMETRICS_ROOT_PATH=/hostfs
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      # Required for CVM guest hostmetrics parity. OTel prefixes host mount
      # points with root_path=/hostfs so the collector reports the guest host,
      # not the collector container filesystem.
      - /:/hostfs:ro
      - /var/lib/docker/containers:/var/lib/docker/containers:ro
      - otelcol-management-storage:/var/lib/otelcol-management
    configs:
      - source: otelcol_management_config
        target: /etc/otelcol-management/config.yaml
        mode: 0444
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Avoid the collector tailing its own Docker JSON log and creating a
    # feedback loop. The host-side Phase 1 collector still captures VM
    # serial/stderr if this sidecar itself needs debugging.
    logging:
      driver: "local"
      options:
        max-size: "20m"
        max-file: "3"


  certbot:
    image: certbot/dns-cloudflare@sha256:742dbd2e61c8709b930712c38958386c3cb3928e09eeb1f1e490600c127e2edb
    restart: unless-stopped
    entrypoint: "/bin/sh -c 'trap exit TERM; while :; do certbot renew; sleep 12h & wait $${!}; done;'"
    volumes:
      - certs:/etc/letsencrypt
    configs:
      - source: cloudflare_credentials
        target: /etc/cloudflare/credentials.ini
        mode: 0600
    depends_on:
      certbot-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source": "dns-cloudflare", "service": "dns-cloudflare"}]'
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "100m"
        max-file: "10"
        labels: "com.datadoghq.ad.logs,com.docker.compose.service"


  certbot-init:
    image: certbot/dns-cloudflare@sha256:742dbd2e61c8709b930712c38958386c3cb3928e09eeb1f1e490600c127e2edb
    volumes:
      - certs:/etc/letsencrypt
    restart: on-failure
    configs:
      - source: cloudflare_credentials
        target: /etc/cloudflare/credentials.ini
        mode: 0600
    command: >
      certonly
      --dns-cloudflare
      --dns-cloudflare-credentials /etc/cloudflare/credentials.ini
      --dns-cloudflare-propagation-seconds 30
      --email ${CERTBOT_EMAIL}
      --agree-tos --no-eff-email --non-interactive
      --key-type ecdsa --elliptic-curve secp256r1
      --cert-name completions.near.ai
      -d "*.completions.near.ai"
      -d "completions.near.ai"
      -d "$HOSTNAME.hosts.near.ai"
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source": "dns-cloudflare", "service": "dns-cloudflare"}]'
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "100m"
        max-file: "10"
        labels: "com.datadoghq.ad.logs,com.docker.compose.service"


  compose-manager:
    image: ${COMPOSE_MANAGER_IMAGE:-nearaidev/compose-manager@sha256:6e035c8fb99c1d31f41760d25af178683a658cca4afd73cd0d366fbb5bf884be}
    container_name: compose-manager
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    # pid:host + CAP_SYS_ADMIN + CAP_SYS_PTRACE let compose-manager run
    # `nsenter -t 1 -m -u -i -n -p -- ...` into PID 1's namespaces.
    #   - SYS_PTRACE: needed to open /proc/1/ns/* (ptrace_may_access gates
    #     this — PID 1 has `dumpable=0` because it was launched with a full
    #     cap set, so even root in the same user-ns needs SYS_PTRACE).
    #   - SYS_ADMIN: needed for the setns() that follows the open.
    # Without BOTH, every nsenter call fails with "cannot open /proc/1/ns/*:
    # Permission denied" — affecting `/dstack-agent/:action` (pre-existing)
    # and `/admin/kernel/algif-blacklist` (PR #14 / CVE-2026-31431).
    #
    # NOTE on AppArmor: on a host with AppArmor enabled, docker-default also
    # blocks this regardless of caps; the workable combo there is
    # `cap_add: [SYS_ADMIN, SYS_PTRACE]` PLUS `security_opt:
    # apparmor=unconfined`. dstack-OS does NOT ship AppArmor (verified
    # 2026-05-19 — no apparmor binaries/profiles in the rootfs, no AppArmor
    # strings in bzImage), so we omit the `security_opt` line. If a future
    # dstack-OS image enables AppArmor, this template must add it.
    pid: host
    cap_add:
      - SYS_ADMIN
      - SYS_PTRACE
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
      - /dstack/.host-shared/.decrypted-env:/app/.env:ro
      - work:/app/work
    environment:
      - GITHUB_REPO=https://github.com/nearai/cvm-compose-files
      - BEARER_TOKEN=${BEARER_TOKEN}
      - WORK_DIR=/app/work
      - MIN_TAG_AGE_HOURS=${CM_MIN_TAG_AGE_HOURS:-0}
      - ENV_FILES=/app/.env
      # Slack ops notifications (nearai/infra#141). INSTANCE_LABEL identifies
      # this host in the message ("Deployed on gpuXX"); SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL is a
      # secret sourced from the CVM decrypted env (empty = notifications off).
      - INSTANCE_LABEL=gpu02
      - SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source": "compose-manager", "service": "compose-manager"}]'
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "100m"
        max-file: "10"
        labels: "com.datadoghq.ad.logs,com.docker.compose.service"


  compose-manager-launcher:
    image: nearaidev/compose-manager-launcher@sha256:079a14b41deb11e0e27f9b69648e8b3d89bd6fb9ccf6071643b8f447fa415085
    container_name: compose-manager-launcher
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Host network so the launcher's health check (LAUNCHER_HEALTH_URL below,
    # http://127.0.0.1:8080/version) can reach compose-manager, which publishes
    # 8080 on the guest host via `ports: 8080:8080`. On the default bridge,
    # 127.0.0.1 is the launcher's own loopback and the check can never pass —
    # every swap/rollback would be wrongly declared failed.
    network_mode: host
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      # Mounted read-only so the launcher can pass it as --env-file to docker compose,
      # allowing BEARER_TOKEN and other secrets to be substituted in the bundled
      # compose file without the launcher holding them in its own environment.
      - /dstack/.host-shared/.decrypted-env:/dstack-env:ro
      - work:/app/work
    environment:
      - COMPOSE_MANAGER_IMAGE_REPO=nearaidev/compose-manager
      # Keep launcher-driven recreates aligned with the initially booted
      # compose-manager container; the launcher's bundled compose file also
      # consumes this value.
      - CM_MIN_TAG_AGE_HOURS=${CM_MIN_TAG_AGE_HOURS:-0}
      - LAUNCHER_CHANNEL=${LAUNCHER_CHANNEL:-latest}
      - LAUNCHER_COMPOSE_PROJECT=dstack
      - LAUNCHER_ENV_FILE=/app/work/.env.launcher
      - LAUNCHER_BASE_ENV_FILE=/dstack-env
      - LAUNCHER_HEALTH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080/version
      # compose-manager does TLS/cert + S3 + git work on startup, so a container
      # recreate can take >60s to answer /version. 60s caused a genuine swap (and
      # its rollback) to be declared failed mid-startup -> false 30-min backoff.
      - LAUNCHER_HEALTH_TIMEOUT=180
      - LAUNCHER_COSIGN_IDENTITY_REGEXP=https://github.com/nearai/compose-manager/.github/workflows/.*
      - DOCKER_REGISTRY_USER=${DOCKER_REGISTRY_USER:-}
      - DOCKER_REGISTRY_TOKEN=${DOCKER_REGISTRY_TOKEN:-}
      - LAUNCHER_STATE_FILE=/app/work/launcher-state.json
    depends_on:
      - compose-manager
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source": "compose-manager-launcher", "service": "compose-manager-launcher"}]'
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "100m"
        max-file: "10"
        labels: "com.datadoghq.ad.logs,com.docker.compose.service"


networks:
  # Model compose files attach to this shared network so app-side telemetry can
  # reach management services without restarting the compose-manager CVM for
  # model scrape/log/trace changes.
  default:
    name: dstack_default

volumes:
  otelcol-management-storage:

  work:
  # This volume can be re-used by other containers that need access to the TLS certificates.
  certs:
    name: certs

configs:
  cloudflare_credentials:
    content: |
      dns_cloudflare_api_token = ${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}

  
  # otelcol-management config for compose-manager/launcher telemetry only.
# Dollar signs are escaped as $$ so docker compose leaves OTel's
# ${env:...} references intact.
  otelcol_management_config:
    content: |
      receivers:
        filelog/docker_containers:
          include: [/var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log]
          start_at: end
          storage: file_storage
          include_file_path: true
          operators:
            - type: json_parser
              parse_from: body
              parse_to: attributes
              timestamp:
                parse_from: attributes.time
                layout_type: gotime
                layout: '2006-01-02T15:04:05.999999999Z07:00'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: move
              from: attributes.log
              to: body
              if: 'attributes.log != nil'
            - type: move
              from: attributes.stream
              to: attributes["log.iostream"]
              if: 'attributes.stream != nil'
            - type: remove
              field: attributes.time
              if: 'attributes.time != nil'
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["log.file.path"]
              regex: '/var/lib/docker/containers/(?P<container_id>[a-f0-9]{12})[a-f0-9]*/'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: add
              field: attributes["service.name"]
              value: cvm-docker

        hostmetrics/cvm:
          collection_interval: 30s
          root_path: $${env:CVM_HOSTMETRICS_ROOT_PATH}
          scrapers:
            cpu: {}
            memory: {}
            load: {}
            paging: {}
            network: {}
            disk: {}
            filesystem:
              exclude_mount_points:
                mount_points: ["^/dev(/.*)?$", "^/proc(/.*)?$", "^/sys(/.*)?$", "^/run(/.*)?$", "^/var/lib/docker(/.*)?$"]
                match_type: regexp

        docker_stats/cvm:
          endpoint: unix:///var/run/docker.sock
          collection_interval: 30s
          timeout: 10s
          api_version: "1.44"
          container_labels_to_metric_labels:
            com.docker.compose.service: compose_service
            com.docker.compose.project: compose_project

        prometheus/self:
          config:
            scrape_configs:
              - job_name: otelcol-management
                scrape_interval: 30s
                static_configs:
                  - targets: ['localhost:8888']

      processors:
        memory_limiter:
          check_interval: 1s
          limit_mib: 512
          spike_limit_mib: 128

        resource:
          attributes:
            - key: host.name
              value: $${env:DD_HOSTNAME}
              action: upsert
            - key: cvm.name
              value: $${env:CVM_NAME}
              action: upsert
            - key: host.machine
              value: $${env:CVM_HOST}
              action: insert
            - key: deployment.environment
              value: $${env:ENV}
              action: upsert
            - key: service.namespace
              value: near-ai
              action: insert

        transform/docker_metadata:
          error_mode: ignore
          log_statements:
            - context: log
              statements:
                - set(attributes["service.name"], attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"] != nil
                - set(attributes["service.name"], ParseJSON(attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"])[0]["service"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"] != nil
                - set(attributes["log.source"], ParseJSON(attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"])[0]["source"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"] != nil
                - set(attributes["container.name"], attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"] != nil

        filter/management_logs:
          error_mode: ignore
          logs:
            log_record:
              - 'attributes["service.name"] != "compose-manager" and attributes["service.name"] != "compose-manager-launcher" and attributes["service.name"] != "dns-cloudflare"'

        groupbyattrs/docker_service:
          keys:
            - service.name
            - container.name
            - log.source
            - log.iostream

        batch:
          send_batch_size: 1024
          send_batch_max_size: 2048
          timeout: 5s

      exporters:
        otlphttp/gateway:
          endpoint: https://telemetry.infra.near.ai
          headers:
            Authorization: "Bearer $${env:MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN}"
          # Keep source requests FIFO before the central gateway.
          sending_queue:
            num_consumers: 1
            queue_size: 128
            storage: file_storage

      extensions:
        file_storage:
          directory: /var/lib/otelcol-management/storage
          create_directory: true

      service:
        extensions: [file_storage]
        pipelines:
          logs/cvm:
            receivers: [filelog/docker_containers]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, transform/docker_metadata, filter/management_logs, groupbyattrs/docker_service, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
          metrics/cvm_system:
            receivers: [hostmetrics/cvm, docker_stats/cvm]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
          metrics/self:
            receivers: [prometheus/self]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
        telemetry:
          metrics:
            address: localhost:8888
          logs:
            level: info
",
    "kms_enabled": true,
    "gateway_enabled": false,
    "local_key_provider_enabled": false,
    "key_provider_id": "",
    "public_logs": false,
    "public_sysinfo": true,
    "allowed_envs": [
        "BEARER_TOKEN",
        "CM_MIN_TAG_AGE_HOURS",
        "SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL",
        "AWS_REGION",
        "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID",
        "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY",
        "AWS_S3_BUCKET",
        "CERTBOT_EMAIL",
        "CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN",
        "DOCKER_REGISTRY_USER",
        "DOCKER_REGISTRY_TOKEN",
        "LAUNCHER_CHANNEL",
        "DD_API_KEY",
        "HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN",
        "PROXY_TOKEN",
        "ENV",
        "HOST_IP",
        "DD_HOSTNAME",
        "HOSTNAME",
        "MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN",
        "CVM_NAME",
        "CVM_HOST"
    ],
    "no_instance_id": false,
    "secure_time": false,
    "pre_launch_script": "#!/bin/bash
export ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(cat /dstack/.host-shared/.appkeys.json | jq -r .k256_key)

# Tune kernel for inference workloads
echo 0 > /proc/sys/vm/swappiness            # prevent KV cache swap-out
echo 5 > /proc/sys/vm/dirty_ratio            # reduce write-back cache pressure
echo 1 > /proc/sys/vm/dirty_background_ratio # flush dirty pages sooner

# Restore the launcher's last-known-good image override so a CVM reboot
# doesn't revert compose-manager to the Ansible-baked fallback digest.
# Parse the file as data (not `. file`) — sourcing would execute any
# shell metacharacters in the value, which is a root-RCE path if the
# launcher ever wrote an unvalidated digest. Path assumes default
# Docker data-root; dstack CVMs always use this.
OVERRIDES="/var/lib/docker/volumes/dstack_work/_data/.env.launcher"
# Forced re-pin (repin_launcher_override=true): the launcher persists the
# last image it swapped to in $OVERRIDES, and the compose template gives
# that value precedence over the Ansible-pinned digest. After a promote we
# may intentionally recreate hosts whose persisted override is now stale
# (a pre-promote digest); overwrite it with the pinned image so
# compose-manager boots directly on the promoted digest instead of the
# superseded one. The launcher re-seeds this file from the running
# container on its next successful poll.
if [ "false" = "true" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OVERRIDES")"
  printf 'COMPOSE_MANAGER_IMAGE=%s\n' 'nearaidev/compose-manager@sha256:6e035c8fb99c1d31f41760d25af178683a658cca4afd73cd0d366fbb5bf884be' > "$OVERRIDES"
  echo "[pre_launch] Re-pinned compose-manager image override to nearaidev/compose-manager@sha256:6e035c8fb99c1d31f41760d25af178683a658cca4afd73cd0d366fbb5bf884be"
fi
if [ -f "$OVERRIDES" ]; then
  while IFS='=' read -r k v; do
    case "$k" in COMPOSE_MANAGER_IMAGE) export "$k=$v" ;; esac
  done < "$OVERRIDES"
  echo "[pre_launch] Loaded compose-manager image override from $OVERRIDES"
fi
"
}

gateway_report.app_compose:
{
    "manifest_version": 2,
    "name": "dstack-0.5.12",
    "runner": "docker-compose",
    "docker_compose_file": "# Docker Compose configuration for Cloud API in a VPC environment
# This setup includes the dstack-service for VPC management and an init container
# to prepare necessary configuration files before starting the Cloud API service.

services:
  
  # OpenTelemetry collector sidecar for in-CVM logs/metrics/traces.
  otelcol-contrib:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib@sha256:85ac41c2db88d0df9bd6145e608a3cb023f5d8443868adbfbbf66efb51087917
    container_name: otelcol-contrib
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol-contrib/config.yaml"]
    user: "0:0"
    mem_limit: "512m"
    environment:
      - MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN=${MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN}
      - CVM_NAME=${CVM_NAME}
      - CVM_HOST=${CVM_HOST}
      - DD_HOSTNAME=${DD_HOSTNAME}
      - ENV=${ENV}
      - CVM_HOSTMETRICS_ROOT_PATH=/hostfs
      
    expose:
      - "4317"
      - "4318"
    volumes:
      # Required for Prometheus docker_sd_configs. The scrape rules below only
      # keep containers explicitly labeled nearai.otel.scrape=true.
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      # Required for CVM guest hostmetrics parity. OTel prefixes host mount
      # points with root_path=/hostfs so the collector reports the guest host,
      # not the collector container filesystem.
      - /:/hostfs:ro
      - /var/lib/docker/containers:/var/lib/docker/containers:ro
      
      - otelcol-identity:/telemetry:ro
      
      - otelcol-storage:/var/lib/otelcol-contrib
    configs:
      - source: otelcol_cvm_config
        target: /etc/otelcol-contrib/config.yaml
        mode: 0444
    
    # Identity-enabled CVMs declare their startup prerequisites through
    # cvm_telemetry_depends_on_config.
    depends_on:
        api-init:
          condition: service_completed_successfully

    
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Avoid the collector tailing its own Docker JSON log and creating a
    # feedback loop. The host-side Phase 1 collector still captures VM
    # serial/stderr if this sidecar itself needs debugging.
    logging:
      driver: "local"
      options:
        max-size: "20m"
        max-file: "3"


  # VPC Services Definition
  dstack-vpc-client:
    image: nearaidev/dstack-vpc-client@sha256:dd570dee92901c6d9cf96909404bb5177294437e3642541225a85b06cefa3d9d
    container_name: dstack-vpc-client
    restart: on-failure
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
      - SYS_MODULE
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    network_mode: host
    volumes:
      - vpc_shared:/shared
      - vpc_node_data:/var/lib/tailscale
      - /var/run:/var/run
      - /dstack:/dstack
    environment:
      - NODE_NAME=cloud-api-prod
      - TUN_DEV_NAME=tailscale1
      - VPC_SERVER_APP_ID=e78c12915ad57900317b97bd16f59ae13f86f148
      - DSTACK_MESH_URL=http://localhost:9090
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "tailscale", "status"]
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source": "dstack-vpc-client", "service": "dstack-vpc-client"}]'
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "100m"
        max-file: "10"
        labels: "com.datadoghq.ad.logs,com.docker.compose.service"


  dstack-service-mesh:
    image: nearaidev/dstack-vpc@sha256:45f859504c7a66ea562e3230b7a3b482912bdd93f3930d1bb1c2f46e8d84f8f0
    container_name: dstack-service-mesh
    restart: on-failure
    ports:
      - "443:443"
      - "9090:80"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - vpc_shared:/vpc/0:ro
    privileged: true
    environment:
      - DSTACK_GATEWAY_DOMAIN=cvm3.near.ai
      - DSTACK_MESH_BACKEND=127.0.0.1:8000
      - DSTACK_CONTAINER_IMAGE_ID=nearaidev/dstack-vpc@sha256:45f859504c7a66ea562e3230b7a3b482912bdd93f3930d1bb1c2f46e8d84f8f0
      - RUST_LOG=error
    command: /scripts/mesh-serve.sh
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source": "dstack-mesh", "service": "dstack-mesh"}]'
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "100m"
        max-file: "10"
        labels: "com.datadoghq.ad.logs,com.docker.compose.service"


  # Init container to prepare configuration
  api-init:
    image: alpine@sha256:4b7ce07002c69e8f3d704a9c5d6fd3053be500b7f1c69fc0d80990c2ad8dd412
    container_name: api-init
    restart: "no"
    volumes:
      - api_config:/config
      - vpc_shared:/shared
      - cloud-api-identity:/app-identity
      - otelcol-identity:/telemetry
    environment:
      # Base64 survives the host .env / encrypted dstack env / Compose pipeline.
      - CLOUD_API_RDS_PASSWORD_B64=${CLOUD_API_RDS_PASSWORD_B64:?RDS password required}
      - CLOUD_API_RDS_CA_BUNDLE_B64=${CLOUD_API_RDS_CA_BUNDLE_B64:?RDS CA bundle required}
    # Same resolver as cloud-api: 100.100.100.100 + dstack.internal search so the
    # reaper can resolve the leader's *.dstack.internal address; 1.1.1.1 for the
    # public gateway subdomain used during discovery.
    dns:
      - 100.100.100.100
      - 1.1.1.1
    dns_search:
      - dstack.internal
    configs:
      - source: api_init_script
        target: /init.sh
        mode: 0755
    command: ["/init.sh"]

  # Cloud API service
  cloud-api:
    container_name: cloud-api
    image: nearaidev/cloud-api@sha256:d38e6d816454de5c93690ef46f8297fd5e57c6b8c4b5dfe984b7e1229aa6b790
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
      - api_config:/config:ro
      - cloud-api-identity:/run/cloud-api-identity:ro
      - ingress_certs:/ingress-certs:ro
    environment:
      - DATABASE_CONNECTION_MODE=direct
      - DATABASE_HOST=cloudapi-postgres-prod.cx0gm2caeqha.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com
      - DATABASE_PORT=5432
      - DATABASE_TLS_CA_CERT_PATH=/config/rds-ca-bundle.pem
      - VPC_SERVER_APP_ID=e78c12915ad57900317b97bd16f59ae13f86f148
      - SERVER_HOST=0.0.0.0
      - SERVER_PORT=3000
      - DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=32
      - DATABASE_REFRESH_INTERVAL=300
      - MODEL_DISCOVERY_SERVER_URL=${MODEL_DISCOVERY_SERVER_URL}
      - MODEL_DISCOVERY_API_KEY=${MODEL_DISCOVERY_API_KEY}
      # Per-model GPU allocation and burn metrics for the admin dashboard.
      # Values are written to the CVM .env file from the environment-specific
      # vars file and must also be forwarded into the cloud-api container.
      - INFRA_PROMETHEUS_URL=${INFRA_PROMETHEUS_URL}
      - INFRA_PROMETHEUS_BEARER_TOKEN=${INFRA_PROMETHEUS_BEARER_TOKEN}
      - INFRA_PROMETHEUS_ENV=${INFRA_PROMETHEUS_ENV}
      - INFRA_COST_PER_GPU_HOUR_USD=${INFRA_COST_PER_GPU_HOUR_USD}
      - ENABLE_ITA_ATTESTATION=true
      - ITA_API_KEY=${ITA_API_KEY}
      # Shared service-token for POST /v1/internal/usage. Forwarded
      # from the CVM .env file (written by Ansible from the host's
      # CLOUD_API_USAGE_TOKEN env var, in turn from the GH Actions
      # secret of the same name). When the .env doesn't define the
      # var, Docker Compose substitutes "" and cloud-api's config
      # layer coerces empty to None → endpoint stays disabled (503).
      - CLOUD_API_USAGE_TOKEN=${CLOUD_API_USAGE_TOKEN}
      - MODEL_DISCOVERY_REFRESH_INTERVAL=60
      - MODEL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=5
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
      - LOG_FORMAT=json
      - RUST_LOG=info
      - RUST_BACKTRACE=1
      - LOG_MODULE_API=info
      - LOG_MODULE_SERVICES=info
      - DSTACK_CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:8000
      - AUTH_MOCK=false
      - GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=${GITHUB_CLIENT_ID}
      - GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=${GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET}
      - GITHUB_REDIRECT_URL=https://cloud-api.near.ai/v1/auth/callback
      - GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID}
      - GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=${GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET}
      - GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URL=https://cloud-api.near.ai/v1/auth/callback
      - NEAR_EXPECTED_RECIPIENT=${NEAR_EXPECTED_RECIPIENT}
      - AUTH_ADMIN_DOMAINS=${AUTH_ADMIN_DOMAINS}
      - AUTH_ADMIN_READ_ONLY_TOKENS_ENABLED=${AUTH_ADMIN_READ_ONLY_TOKENS_ENABLED:-false}
      - DATABASE_NAME=${DATABASE_NAME}
      - DATABASE_USERNAME=${DATABASE_USERNAME}
      - DATABASE_TLS_ENABLED=true
      - DATABASE_PASSWORD_FILE=/config/postgres-password
      - AUTH_ENCODING_KEY=${AUTH_ENCODING_KEY}
      - VPC_HOSTNAME_FILE=/config/vpc_hostname
      - VPC_SHARED_SECRET_FILE=/config/keyfile
      - S3_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE=/config/s3-encryption-key
      # Domain-separated from the S3 key while retaining the VPC shared key as
      # the root secret. api-init writes the derived value to this private file.
      - DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE=/config/database-encryption-key
      - DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY_ID=${DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY_ID}
      - DB_ENCRYPTION_WRITE_ENABLED=${DB_ENCRYPTION_WRITE_ENABLED:-false}
      - AWS_S3_BUCKET=${AWS_S3_BUCKET}
      - AWS_S3_REGION=${AWS_S3_REGION}
      - AWS_REGION=${AWS_S3_REGION}
      - AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      - AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
      - BRAVE_SEARCH_PRO_API_KEY=${BRAVE_SEARCH_PRO_API_KEY}
      - BRAVE_LLM_CONTEXT_API_KEY=${BRAVE_LLM_CONTEXT_API_KEY}
      - GATEWAY_SUBDOMAIN=cvm3.near.ai
      - CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=${CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS}
      - ENVIRONMENT=prod
      # Allocation order and version are persisted with each usage funding
      # split. Bump the version whenever the policy meaning changes.
      - CREDIT_USAGE_ORDER=${CREDIT_USAGE_ORDER:-grant,staking_farm,payment,postpay}
      - CREDIT_ALLOCATION_POLICY_VERSION=${CREDIT_ALLOCATION_POLICY_VERSION:-v1}
      # House of Stake farm credits (nearai/cloud-api#856). Shared template
      # passthroughs default hard-off so production remains disabled unless its
      # vars file explicitly opts in. Staging sets the contract/product IDs in
      # vars/cloud_api_stg.yaml.
      - STAKING_FARM_ENABLED=${STAKING_FARM_ENABLED:-false}
      - STAKING_FARM_SELECTED_ORG_BINDING_ENABLED=${STAKING_FARM_SELECTED_ORG_BINDING_ENABLED:-false}
      - NEAR_RPC_URL=${NEAR_RPC_URL:-https://free.rpc.fastnear.com}
      - NEAR_NETWORK_ID=${NEAR_NETWORK_ID:-mainnet}
      - NEAR_STAKING_CONTRACT_ID=${NEAR_STAKING_CONTRACT_ID:-}
      - STAKING_FARM_PRODUCT_ID=${STAKING_FARM_PRODUCT_ID:-}
      - STAKING_FARM_PRICE_ID=${STAKING_FARM_PRICE_ID:-}
      - STAKING_FARM_CREDIT_NANO_USD_PER_REWARD_UNIT=${STAKING_FARM_CREDIT_NANO_USD_PER_REWARD_UNIT:-1000000000}
      - STAKING_FARM_SYNC_STALENESS_SECONDS=${STAKING_FARM_SYNC_STALENESS_SECONDS:-300}
      # Lukka AML checks for NEAR wallet-gated House of Stake flows
      # (nearai/cloud-api#909). This template forwards cloud-api's AML-scoped
      # env names; the vars files reuse the same per-environment Lukka secrets
      # already used by chat-api.
      - LUKKA_AML_ENABLED=${LUKKA_AML_ENABLED:-false}
      - LUKKA_AML_BEARER_TOKEN=${LUKKA_AML_BEARER_TOKEN:-}
      - LUKKA_AML_BASE_URL=${LUKKA_AML_BASE_URL:-https://api.blockchain-analytics.lukka.tech}
      - LUKKA_AML_REPORT_REFRESH_DAYS=${LUKKA_AML_REPORT_REFRESH_DAYS:-30}
      - LUKKA_AML_MEMORY_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS=${LUKKA_AML_MEMORY_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS:-300}
      - LUKKA_AML_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=${LUKKA_AML_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-10}
      - LUKKA_AML_BLOCKED_RISK_LEVELS=${LUKKA_AML_BLOCKED_RISK_LEVELS:-}
      - LUKKA_AML_SCORE_BLOCK_THRESHOLD=${LUKKA_AML_SCORE_BLOCK_THRESHOLD:-46}
      - LUKKA_AML_HIGH_RISK_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=${LUKKA_AML_HIGH_RISK_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}
      - LUKKA_AML_HIGH_RISK_SLACK_TIMEOUT_MS=${LUKKA_AML_HIGH_RISK_SLACK_TIMEOUT_MS:-3000}
      - TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME=cloud-api
      - TELEMETRY_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://otelcol-contrib:4317
      - TELEMETRY_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID_FILE=/run/cloud-api-identity/instance_id
      - GEMINI_API_KEY=${GEMINI_API_KEY}
      - OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY}
      - ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}
      - TYPESAFE_API_KEY=${TYPESAFE_API_KEY:-}
      # Canonical model IDs eligible for native stateless Responses. Empty disables routing.
      - NATIVE_RESPONSES_MODELS=${NATIVE_RESPONSES_MODELS:-}
      # Native Anthropic Messages endpoints. Included only when an environment
      # explicitly opts in; production renders no setting and remains hard-off.
      - ENABLE_ANTHROPIC_MESSAGES=${ENABLE_ANTHROPIC_MESSAGES:-false}
      # Extra anthropic-beta tokens admitted by the native Messages routes on
      # top of the image's built-in allowlist. Rendered only when set.
      - ANTHROPIC_ALLOWED_BETAS=${ANTHROPIC_ALLOWED_BETAS:-}
      - EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT=${EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT}
      - INVITATION_EMAIL_ENABLED=${INVITATION_EMAIL_ENABLED}
      - CONTACT_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_ENABLED=${CONTACT_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_ENABLED:-false}
      - INVITATION_EMAIL_FROM=${INVITATION_EMAIL_FROM}
      - RESEND_API_KEY=${RESEND_API_KEY}
      - CLOUD_UI_BASE_URL=${CLOUD_UI_BASE_URL}
      # Chutes attested third-party provider (nearai/cloud-api#758). Forwarded
      # from the CVM .env (set only where the vars file defines them — staging
      # for now). Missing → Compose substitutes the defaults below → cloud-api
      # keeps Chutes hard-off (ENABLE_CHUTES != "true"/"1"; empty key → None —
      # cloud-api config filters `CHUTES_API_KEY=""` to absent via
      # `.filter(|s| !s.is_empty())`, so it fails closed (provider not registered);
      # empty CHUTES_MODELS → no models). So this passthrough is a no-op for
      # prod until its vars file opts in. CHUTES_ENABLE_STREAMING defaults off;
      # opt in per-environment via the vars file (see vars/cloud_api_stg.yaml for
      # the streaming-safety analysis). PCCS is intentionally omitted (unset →
      # dcap-qvl default collateral).
      # AUDIT NOTE: this template is shared with prod (vars/cloud_api_prod.yaml).
      # Adding these four passthroughs changes prod's rendered compose and thus its
      # KMS-registered attestation measurement; the daily 02:00 UTC
      # update_cloud_api_prod.yml cron re-registers it (idempotent add-hash with an
      # on-chain pre-check) within ~24h. Behaviorally a no-op for prod — the `:-`
      # defaults resolve Chutes hard-off — but the measurement digest does change.
      - ENABLE_CHUTES=${ENABLE_CHUTES:-false}
      - CHUTES_ENABLE_STREAMING=${CHUTES_ENABLE_STREAMING:-false}
      - CHUTES_MODELS=${CHUTES_MODELS:-}
      - CHUTES_API_KEY=${CHUTES_API_KEY:-}
      # Tinfoil attested fallback provider (nearai/cloud-api#1213). Empty defaults
      # keep Tinfoil off (empty models register nothing; empty key is absent).
      - TINFOIL_MODELS=${TINFOIL_MODELS:-}
      - TINFOIL_API_KEY=${TINFOIL_API_KEY:-}
      # OHTTP gateway (RFC 9458). Off by default; opt in per-environment
      # via env_vars (vars/cloud_api_stg.yaml sets OHTTP_ENABLED=true).
      - OHTTP_ENABLED=${OHTTP_ENABLED:-false}
      # Smart-placement replica state (cloud-api reads signed state from the
      # shared Valkey). Values come from the CVM .env written from the
      # environment-specific vars file. An empty PLACEMENT_REDIS_HOST (or
      # password) leaves placement off with legacy routing, and the TLS CA may be
      # a one-line PEM with literal \n escapes. Rendered only where the vars file
      # defines PLACEMENT_REDIS_HOST, so prod stays dark until it opts in.
      # AUDIT NOTE: this template is shared with prod; the guard keeps prod's
      # rendered compose, and so its KMS measurement, unchanged.
      - PLACEMENT_REDIS_HOST=${PLACEMENT_REDIS_HOST:-}
      - PLACEMENT_REDIS_PORT=${PLACEMENT_REDIS_PORT:-6379}
      - PLACEMENT_REDIS_TLS_ENABLED=${PLACEMENT_REDIS_TLS_ENABLED:-true}
      - PLACEMENT_REDIS_TLS_CA_CERT=${PLACEMENT_REDIS_TLS_CA_CERT:-}
      - PLACEMENT_REDIS_PASSWORD=${PLACEMENT_REDIS_PASSWORD:-}
      - TLS_CERT_PATH=/ingress-certs/cloud-api.near.ai/fullchain.pem
    dns:
      - 100.100.100.100
      - 1.1.1.1
    dns_search:
      - dstack.internal
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    depends_on:
      api-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      ingress:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://127.0.0.1:3000/v1/model/list || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 40s
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source": "cloud-api", "service": "cloud-api"}]'
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "100m"
        max-file: "10"
        labels: "com.datadoghq.ad.logs,com.docker.compose.service"


  # Ingress sidecar: nginx reverse proxy (TLS optional)
  ingress:
    container_name: ingress
    image: nearaidev/cvm-ingress@sha256:1653c23200298a823c08c66d829c633fc36919bca1e09cf577b83b01353e0891
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - DOMAIN=cloud-api.near.ai
      - BACKEND_HOST=cloud-api
      - BACKEND_PORT=3000
      - TLS_ENABLED=true
      - CERTBOT_EMAIL=${CERTBOT_EMAIL}
      - CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}
      - S3_BUCKET=${INGRESS_S3_BUCKET}
      - S3_PREFIX=cloud-api-prod
      - AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      - AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
      - AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=${AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}
      - STAGING=false
    volumes:
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
      - ingress_certs:/certs
    ports:
      - "8443:8443"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "test -f /certs/cloud-api.near.ai/fullchain.pem"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 60
      start_period: 10s
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source": "nginx", "service": "ingress", "tags": ["role:ingress", "deployment:cloud-api-prod", "env:${ENV}", "host:${CVM_HOST}", "ip:${HOST_IP}", "port:8443", "domain:cloud-api.near.ai"]}]'
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "100m"
        max-file: "10"
        labels: "com.datadoghq.ad.logs,com.docker.compose.service"


volumes:
  otelcol-storage:
  otelcol-identity:

  cloud-api-identity:
  api_config:
  ingress_certs:
  # VPC Volumes
  vpc_shared:
  vpc_node_data:


configs:
  
  # otelcol-contrib config for guest-level CVM telemetry. Dollar signs are
# escaped as $$ so docker compose leaves OTel's ${env:...} references intact.
  otelcol_cvm_config:
    content: |
      receivers:
        otlp:
          protocols:
            grpc:
              endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
            http:
              endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318

        filelog/docker_containers:
          include: [/var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log]
          start_at: end
          storage: file_storage
          include_file_path: true
          operators:
            - type: json_parser
              parse_from: body
              parse_to: attributes
              timestamp:
                parse_from: attributes.time
                layout_type: gotime
                layout: '2006-01-02T15:04:05.999999999Z07:00'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: move
              from: attributes.log
              to: body
              if: 'attributes.log != nil'
            - type: move
              from: attributes.stream
              to: attributes["log.iostream"]
              if: 'attributes.stream != nil'
            - type: remove
              field: attributes.time
              if: 'attributes.time != nil'
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["log.file.path"]
              regex: '/var/lib/docker/containers/(?P<container_id>[a-f0-9]{12})[a-f0-9]*/'
              on_error: send_quiet
            # Preserve the low-cardinality Datadog autodiscovery tags operators
            # already use as log filters. High-cardinality tags like instance
            # and model_path stay inside the raw Docker label metadata.
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'model:(?P<model>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'deployment:(?P<deployment>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'ip:(?P<ip>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'port:(?P<port>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'env:(?P<env>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'host:(?P<host>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: add
              field: attributes["service.name"]
              value: cvm-docker

        hostmetrics/cvm:
          collection_interval: 30s
          root_path: $${env:CVM_HOSTMETRICS_ROOT_PATH}
          scrapers:
            cpu: {}
            memory: {}
            load: {}
            paging: {}
            network: {}
            disk: {}
            filesystem:
              exclude_mount_points:
                mount_points: ["^/dev(/.*)?$", "^/proc(/.*)?$", "^/sys(/.*)?$", "^/run(/.*)?$", "^/var/lib/docker(/.*)?$"]
                match_type: regexp

        docker_stats/cvm:
          endpoint: unix:///var/run/docker.sock
          collection_interval: 30s
          timeout: 10s
          api_version: "1.44"
          container_labels_to_metric_labels:
            com.docker.compose.service: compose_service
            com.docker.compose.project: compose_project

        prometheus/self:
          config:
            scrape_configs:
              - job_name: otelcol-cvm
                scrape_interval: 30s
                static_configs:
                  - targets: ['localhost:8888']
              - job_name: docker-labeled-services
                scrape_interval: 15s
                docker_sd_configs:
                  - host: unix:///var/run/docker.sock
                    refresh_interval: 30s
                relabel_configs:
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_scrape]
                    regex: "true"
                    action: keep
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_network_name]
                    regex: dstack_default
                    action: keep
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_port]
                    regex: ".+"
                    action: keep
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_network_ip, __meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_port]
                    separator: ":"
                    target_label: __address__
                    replacement: "$$1:$$2"
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_path]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: __metrics_path__
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_job]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: job
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_service]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: service
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_com_docker_compose_service]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: container_name
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_model]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: model
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_deployment]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: deployment
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_env]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: env
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_host]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: host
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_ip]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: ip
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_port]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: port
              
        

      processors:
        memory_limiter:
          check_interval: 1s
          limit_mib: 256
          spike_limit_mib: 64

        resource:
          attributes:
            - key: host.name
              value: $${env:DD_HOSTNAME}
              action: upsert
            - key: cvm.name
              value: $${env:CVM_NAME}
              action: upsert
            - key: host.machine
              value: $${env:CVM_HOST}
              action: insert
            - key: deployment.environment
              value: $${env:ENV}
              action: upsert
            - key: service.namespace
              value: near-ai
              action: insert

        
        resource/cvm_instance:
          attributes:
            - key: cvm.instance.id
              value: $${file:/telemetry/instance_id}
              action: upsert

        # dstack-vpc-client writes instance_id with echo, so strip its trailing
        # newline before Prometheus converts cvm.instance.id to cvm_instance_id.
        transform/cvm_instance:
          error_mode: propagate
          metric_statements:
            - replace_pattern(resource.attributes["cvm.instance.id"], "\\s+$", "")
            - delete_key(resource.attributes, "cvm.instance.id") where resource.attributes["cvm.instance.id"] == "unavailable"
          log_statements:
            - context: resource
              statements:
                - replace_pattern(attributes["cvm.instance.id"], "\\s+$", "")
                - delete_key(attributes, "cvm.instance.id") where attributes["cvm.instance.id"] == "unavailable"
          trace_statements:
            - context: resource
              statements:
                - replace_pattern(attributes["cvm.instance.id"], "\\s+$", "")
                - delete_key(attributes, "cvm.instance.id") where attributes["cvm.instance.id"] == "unavailable"
        

        transform/docker_metadata:
          error_mode: ignore
          log_statements:
            - context: log
              statements:
                - set(attributes["service.name"], attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"] != nil
                - set(attributes["service.name"], ParseJSON(attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"])[0]["service"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"] != nil
                - set(attributes["log.source"], ParseJSON(attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"])[0]["source"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"] != nil
                - set(attributes["container.name"], attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"] != nil

        groupbyattrs/docker_service:
          keys:
            - service.name
            - container.name
            - log.source
            - log.iostream
            - model
            - deployment
            - env
            - host
            - ip
            - port

        batch:
          send_batch_size: 1024
          send_batch_max_size: 2048
          timeout: 5s

      exporters:
        otlphttp/gateway:
          endpoint: https://telemetry.infra.near.ai
          headers:
            Authorization: "Bearer $${env:MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN}"
          # Keep source requests FIFO. The Collector default is ten queue
          # consumers; once they reorder cumulative samples, the gateway's
          # serialized remote-write queue cannot restore their order.
          sending_queue:
            num_consumers: 1
            queue_size: 128
            storage: file_storage
        

      extensions:
        file_storage:
          directory: /var/lib/otelcol-contrib/storage
          create_directory: true

      service:
        extensions: [file_storage]
        pipelines:
          logs/cvm:
            receivers: [filelog/docker_containers]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, resource/cvm_instance, transform/cvm_instance, transform/docker_metadata, groupbyattrs/docker_service, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
          metrics/cvm_system:
            receivers: [hostmetrics/cvm, docker_stats/cvm]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, resource/cvm_instance, transform/cvm_instance, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
          logs/otlp:
            receivers: [otlp]

  api_init_script:
    content: |
      #!/bin/sh
      set -e

      echo "Cloud API initialization starting..."

      # Wait for file to exist in /shared
      echo "Waiting for /shared/shared_key to exist..."
      while [ ! -f /shared/shared_key ]; do
        sleep 2
      done
      echo "/shared/shared_key exists"

      # Stage only the canonical dstack identity into separate app and collector
      # volumes. Neither consumer receives the credential-bearing VPC volume.
      INSTANCE_ID_WAIT_ATTEMPTS=$${INSTANCE_ID_WAIT_ATTEMPTS:-60}
      INSTANCE_ID_WAIT_SECONDS=$${INSTANCE_ID_WAIT_SECONDS:-2}
      echo "Waiting for /shared/instance_id to exist..."
      for _ in $$(seq 1 "$$INSTANCE_ID_WAIT_ATTEMPTS"); do
        if [ -s /shared/instance_id ]; then
          break
        fi
        sleep "$$INSTANCE_ID_WAIT_SECONDS"
      done
      if [ ! -s /shared/instance_id ]; then
        echo "dstack instance identity was not staged" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      INSTANCE_ID=$$(sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$$//' /shared/instance_id)
      if [ -z "$$INSTANCE_ID" ]; then
        echo "dstack instance identity is empty after trimming" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      umask 077
      printf '%s' "$$INSTANCE_ID" > /app-identity/instance_id
      printf '%s' "$$INSTANCE_ID" > /telemetry/instance_id
      chmod 0444 /app-identity/instance_id /telemetry/instance_id
      unset INSTANCE_ID

      echo "Copying shared key to /config/keyfile..."
      cp /shared/shared_key /config/keyfile
      chmod 644 /config/keyfile

      # Decode only inside the CVM; never place raw credentials in Compose.
      # RDS material is independent of the unchanged VPC-derived encryption keys.
      umask 077
      if ! printf '%s' "$${CLOUD_API_RDS_PASSWORD_B64:?}" | base64 -d > /config/postgres-password; then
        echo "Invalid RDS password encoding" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      if ! printf '%s' "$${CLOUD_API_RDS_CA_BUNDLE_B64:?}" | base64 -d > /config/rds-ca-bundle.pem; then
        echo "Invalid RDS CA bundle encoding" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      test -s /config/postgres-password
      test -s /config/rds-ca-bundle.pem
      chown 1000:1000 /config/postgres-password /config/rds-ca-bundle.pem
      chmod 600 /config/postgres-password /config/rds-ca-bundle.pem
      unset CLOUD_API_RDS_PASSWORD_B64 CLOUD_API_RDS_CA_BUNDLE_B64

      echo "Copying actual hostname to /config/vpc_hostname..."
      cp /shared/actual_hostname /config/vpc_hostname
      chmod 644 /config/vpc_hostname

      # Derive S3 encryption key (32 bytes) from keyfile
      # Read 32 raw bytes, which are then converted to a 64-character hex string.
      S3_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(head -c 32 /config/keyfile | xxd -p | tr -d '\n')
      echo "$$S3_ENCRYPTION_KEY" > /config/s3-encryption-key
      chmod 644 /config/s3-encryption-key

      # Derive a distinct database field-encryption key from the same VPC root
      # secret. The fixed domain label prevents reuse of the S3 key material;
      # the NUL delimiter is part of the versioned derivation. sha256sum emits
      # the 64 lowercase hex characters expected by cloud-api. Never log it.
      umask 077
      {
        printf 'nearai-cloud-api/database-field-encryption/v1\000'
        cat /config/keyfile
      } | sha256sum | awk '{print $$1}' > /config/database-encryption-key
      # cloud-api runs as UID/GID 1000 and mounts api_config read-only.
      chown 1000:1000 /config/database-encryption-key
      chmod 600 /config/database-encryption-key

      echo "Initialization complete"

",
